extra.golden_response:
Correct answer: Red blood cells (erythrocytes)

Erythrocytes are packed with hemoglobin, whose iron centers bind O2 in the lungs and release it in tissues. Leukocytes serve immune defense and platelets serve clotting; neither carries meaningful oxygen.
